messages:
ashley: Heads-up: ran rwd-v7-int6 through our mixed-slice onboarding harness (n=6k). Quick TL;DR below.

lee: paste numbers pls.

ashley: Latency: p50 -15%, p95 -20% on A100 dev pool. Cost est -30%.

ashley: Quality: short answers ~parity; long-doc fidelity drop ~2.1% abs on citation accuracy; multi-step correctness down ~2.6% abs. Safety checks show +0.2% false-positive flags.

rana: yikes. Are hallucinations concentrated on extraction vs synthesis?

ashley: Mostly synthesis across multi-document prompts and long-context summarization. Spot analysis shows model invents minor facts when source ambiguity exists.

ops-bot: scheduled rollout: 10% soft-promote for rwd-v7-int6 at 2025-03-15T09:00Z pending manual approve.

lee: hold that. propose: spin 0.2% canary with shadow + automatic rerank to baseline for low-confidence outputs. gating rules suggestion: hall_abs_delta_threshold=1.0%, agreement_min=93%, p95_latency_delta_max=50ms, CI_lower_bound_alert=1.0%. immediate fallback if CI lower bound > threshold.

ashley: sounds good. I'll add avg-logprob-delta as a soft signal and compute per-slice deltas. Draft gate config: {"target_pct":"0.2","duration_hours":"24","metrics":["hall_abs_delta","agreement_pct","p95_latency_delta","avg_logprob_delta"],"auto_fallback":"true","fallback_policy":"route-to-baseline","monitoring_hooks":["eval-bot/report","trace-collector"]}.

eval-bot: quick snapshot: rwd-v7-int6 (n=6000) halluc_est=5.3% (CI +/-0.45%), baseline rwd-v7-fp16=2.9% (CI +/-0.35%) -> abs_delta ~2.4% (CI lower bound 1.65%) . Samples at //internal/snapshots/1750001111/v7-int6-regressions.log

rana: CI LB > 1.0% threshold. auto-fallback would trigger.

lee: propose experiments instead of promote: 1) hybrid quant (int6 embeddings+lm_head, fp16 body) 2) keep beam-rerank by fp16 baseline 3) enable calibration post-process (self-check) for synthesis outputs. If hybrid reduces hall_abs_delta < 1.0% and agreement > 94% then consider staged increase.

ashley: plan: cancel 10% soft-promote, launch 0.2% canary with shadow+rerank, and run hybrid shadow in parallel. Collect 48h metrics and attach detailed diff. I'll create ticket RL-3589 and attach artifacts.

ops-bot: RL-3589 created by ashley.

lee: add rollback snippet to ticket: `redwood rollout cancel --id RL-3589 && redwood route set default rwd-v7-fp16`. Include playbook link.

rana: also add a monitor that alerts if hallucination abs delta CI lower bound > 0.8% for any user-facing slice.

ashley: noted. I'll post the canary link when live. :rocket:
